title: My Portfolio
description: Building a component-driven interactive portfolio that accelerates case study publishing and showcases high-craft execution.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: High-craft execution with zero development waste
body: Static portfolios often feel disconnected from actual product craft. I designed and built My Portfolio with Next.js 16 and Tailwind v4, combining interactive 3D visual elements and tactile audio micro-feedback with a modular component architecture.

sections.label: Process
sections.heading: Eliminating layout shift and streamlining component reuse
body: Initial testing highlighted viewports clipping on small mobile screens (375px) and inconsistent micro-interaction states. I established unified design tokens, built a context-aware dynamic cursor, and created slide-over drawer sheets to preserve scroll position.
bullets: Standardized color, spacing, and glassmorphic blur tokens across light and dark modes.
Built a context-aware cursor with custom visual states for links, action targets, and media.
Engineered modal drawer sheets for case studies and resumes to maintain page position.

featureTabs.name: Custom Cursor
featureTabs.description: Context-aware dynamic cursor with smooth state changes over links, confidential items, and action targets.

featureTabs.name: 3D Canvas Blob
featureTabs.description: Interactive, distorted glass-like 3D mesh rendered at 60fps with real-time mouse lighting and drag dynamics.

featureTabs.name: Refractive Nav
featureTabs.description: Header navigation with subtle backdrop blur, light/dark ambient mode controls, and transition link effects.

featureTabs.name: Modal Drawers
featureTabs.description: Slide-over sheets for project deep dives, archive filters, and resume view without breaking page scroll context.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: 4x faster publishing and 60fps interactive performance
body: Delivered a single-page interactive experience with 60fps animation performance, automatic Keystatic CMS integration, and responsive layout scaling from 320px to 4K displays.
bullets: Automated Git-backed CMS workflow for instant case study publishing.
Integrated tactile micro-sound cues for interactive feedback.
Modular sheet architecture for deep-dive reading without full page reloads.

sections.label: Reflection
sections.heading: Design systems maximize ongoing development speed
body: Building with modular components and clean state providers makes future updates effortless. Establishing strict design rules up front ensures new content integrates seamlessly without visual or technical debt.
